html.title: Kodesh – Shabbat, holiday and daily times
html.description: קודש – זמני כניסת ויציאת שבת, זמני חגים, זמני היום ההלכתיים, לוח חגים, דף יומי ותפילות. Shabbat and holiday times, zmanim, Jewish holiday calendar, Daf Yomi and prayers.

- button "Back"
- heading "About" [level=2]
- group:
  - text: "Kodesh brings together what you need for Shabbat, holidays and every day: candle lighting and Havdalah times, holiday dates, halachic times of day, a holiday calendar, Daf Yomi and prayers."
  - heading "What you will find here" [level=2]
  - text: "• Candle lighting and Havdalah times for every Shabbat and holiday, for the city you choose or your current location. • Times of day: dawn, sunrise, latest Shema, sunset, nightfall and more. • Yearly and monthly holiday calendar, Rosh Chodesh, Sefirat HaOmer and the Molad. • Candle lighting, Havdalah, putting on tefillin, Birkat HaMazon, the bedtime Shema and more, in the Sefard, Ashkenaz and Edot HaMizrach traditions. • In the phone app: reminders for Shabbat, holidays, tefillin, Rosh Chodesh and the Omer, and a compass."
  - heading "Data sources" [level=2]
  - text: Shabbat, holiday and daily times come from Hebcal.com (Hebcal Jewish Calendar), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Daf Yomi comes from Sefaria.org. Finding your city from your location uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
  - heading "Please note" [level=2]
  - text: Times are calculated automatically and can vary by custom and exact location. For halachic questions or when in doubt, check a local calendar or ask a rabbi. Reminders in the app depend on your device and its settings and may not arrive on time, so please do not rely on them alone.
  - button "Accessibility statement"
  - button "Privacy policy"
